ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominantly low-intensity (black/dark gray) with high-intensity (white) pixel clusters occupying approximately 3-5% of the visible surface area, primarily localized to scar tissue and encrustations.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid dark pigmentation field with isolated, high-contrast contiguous geometric blobs: approximately 6-8 circular white rings (rosettes) distributed across the central and right lobes, and one larger irregular white patch on the medial-left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped central depression with a calculated aperture of approximately 65 degrees and a deep vertical depth relative to the lobe heights.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations extracted along the entire trailing boundary, characterized by a 'saw-tooth' pattern with consistent pixel-amplitude variations of 5-12 units.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex upward curvature originating from the median notch and terminating at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Visible spatial detection of multiple high-contrast circular ring-like pixel clusters consistent with barnacle attachment sites, concentrated on the lower-right and central-medial surfaces.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Low-contrast, unaligned diagonal and horizontal linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) detectable on the lower section of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular biological encrustations (barnacle clusters) localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes, altering the natural geometric termination of the fluke.
other_distinctive_markers: Large, protruding cluster of barnacles on the left lobe tip creates a unique, non-linear morphological expansion beyond the standard edge contour.
